raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Since #44069 removed the per-forward host sync in the Z-Image DiT, the request-mode warmup finishes on the host while its DiT step and decode are still queued on the device. The warmup saves no output, so nothing waits for that work. The next request's first blocking op, the text-encoder offload in TextEncodingStage, waits for it instead. This fails the NPU CI perf check for z_image_t2i_1npu:

TextEncodingStage: ~350 ms → ~600 ms on A3; limit 442 ms.
With SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1 the regression disappears

## Modifications

`gpu_worker.py`: synchronize the device at the end of a warmup request in _finalize_output_batch. The warmup's device work then completes inside the warmup instead of being billed to the next request. Regular requests are unaffected

## Speed Tests and Profiling

`z_image_t2i_1npu`, `TextEncodingStage`, measured on 1 device `Ascend A2`:

```bash
python3 -m pytest -s -v sglang/multimodal_gen/test/server/ascend/test_server_1_npu.py -k z_image_t2i_1npu
```

| Commit | TextEncodingStage |
|---|---|
| `53fe21cdfd~1` | ~500 ms |
| `53fe21cdfd` | ~760 ms |
| `53fe21cdfd` + `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1` | ~300 ms |
| `53fe21cdfd` + this PR | ~300 ms |

## Checklist

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`

# CI Analysis — SGLang PR #44306

**PR:** [#44306 — Z-Image: Synchronize device after warmup request](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44306)  
**PR commit:** `f59b8b9072ce` · **Parent commit:** `bab9c81fea62` · **Checked:** 2026-10-15  
**Change:** Synchronize the device after diffusion warmup in `gpu_worker.py` (+5 lines).

## Passing checks

- **[NPU (Ascend A3)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584628868): PASS.** All four executed diffusion partitions passed; `z_image_t2i_1npu` passed with `TextEncodingStage = 17.06 ms`.
- **[Base](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584629167): PASS.** All executed diffusion tests passed.
- **[Latest PR title check](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38718826532): PASS.**

## Failed checks — PR relationship

| Failed check | Classification | Verified evidence |
|---|---|---|
| [AMD 2-GPU, partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584629094/job/116029626888) | **Not related** | The parent commit, `bab9c81fea62`, already has the same LTX-2.5 server startup timeout (`1200s`) and eventual 180-minute job timeout. [Parent log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38563492873/job/115850314922). |
| [AMD 1-GPU, partition 0](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584629094/job/116029627231) | **Not related** | Both Kandinsky6 Audio VAE exact-output failures also occur on the parent. [Parent log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38563492873/job/115850314547). |
| [AMD 1-GPU, partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584629094/job/116029627125) | **Not related** | The same Dynamo all-reduce failure and four missing `is_full_nvlink` failures occur on the parent. [Parent log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38563492873/job/115850314622). |
| [AMD 1-GPU, partition 2](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584629094/job/116029627433) | **Not related** | The same four FlashAttention cases and three FastH3 subtests fail on the parent. [Parent log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38563492873/job/115850314797). |
| [Extra](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584628911) / [AMD Extra](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584628945) gates and finish checks | **Not related** | Missing `run-ci-extra` label; test jobs were skipped and finish failures cascade from gating. |
| [AMD finish check](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38584629094/job/116146413833) | **Not related** | Aggregate failure from the pre-existing AMD failures above. |

## Conclusion

**No PR-related CI regressions detected.** NPU, Base, and the latest PR title check pass. All AMD failures reproduce on the parent commit; Extra failures are gating artifacts, not test failures. **No CI failure has been attributed to this PR**, subject to normal review and repository merge policy.
